sources.quote: All requests use the base URL
sources.facts: HTTPS adsapi.snapchat.com/v1; Bearer header. Organization-admin-created OAuth app required.
Authorization-code flow and refresh endpoint; snapchat-marketing-api permits reads/writes; snapchat-offline-conversions-api is separate. Protect client secrets; Organization Admin creates apps.
FAQ specifies SSL redirects and no fixed refresh-token expiry; access removal can invalidate refresh. No loopback exception found: paste-token only.
organizations[].organization contains id/name; top-level and per-entity success. No organization-list pagination support located.
GET /organizations/{id}/adaccounts; adaccounts[].adaccount id/name/organization_id/status/currency/timezone. Selected organization must match.
GET /adaccounts/{id}/campaigns; GET /campaigns/{id}. campaigns[].campaign id/name/ad_account_id/status/start_time/end_time. Private ownership GET precedes campaign stats.
GET /adaccounts/{id}/creatives; creatives[].creative id/name/ad_account_id/type/review_status. Existing creatives only; no uploads.
Account/campaign/creative pages support limit and paging.next_link cursor; rebuild fixed URLs. SUCCESS and success appear in official examples; both supported.

sources.quote: spend metric is the only metric available
sources.facts: GET /adaccounts/{id}/stats account spend only; /campaigns/{id}/stats spend/impressions/swipes. R1 TOTAL + explicit ISO start_time/end_time at account-day boundaries. total_stats[].total_stat id/type/granularity/stats; optional provider windows and finalized_data_end_time/conversion_data_processed_end_time retained. No half-open-boundary guarantee found.
Money is micro-units of account currency. Preserve decimal integer strings; reject unsafe JSON numbers.
Average 20 requests/s/app and 10/token; excess returns 429. R1 exposes typed limit_exceeded, no automatic retry or limiter.
Historical deprecation statement only; no current universal sunset promise asserted.
Official SDK search located CAPI clients, not a usable TypeScript Marketing API client/spec. No dependency added. R2 uses verified REST CAPI documentation.
POST /adaccounts/{id}/campaigns; nested objective_v2_type TRAFFIC; explicit PAUSED; daily_budget_micro/start_time/end_time.

sources.quote: Minimum value 5000000 across all supported currencies
sources.facts: POST /campaigns/{id}/adsquads; PAUSED, SNAP_ADS, billing_event IMPRESSION, automatic placement, SWIPES and LOWEST_COST_WITH_MAX_BID. Currency bid minimum 10000 micros; maximum 100000000 for AUD/BAM/CAD/CHF/EUR/GBP/KWD, 500000000 for AED/CNY/DKK/HKD/ILS/INR/NOK/QAR/SAR/SEK/USD. Unknown currencies unsupported.

Attributes table marks delivery_constraint required and specifies DAILY_BUDGET for daily_budget_micro. The Creating an Ad Squad example omits the field; omission does not establish a safe default. OM follows the explicit table: freeze/send DAILY_BUDGET and require the same readback. Missing or different values deny before egress or leave a checkpointed receipt unknown. Independent synthetic payload assertion lives in campaign-deployment.test.ts; no live compatibility claim.
sources.verification: Official documentation fetched as text; no Chrome capture or evidence-chrome.md produced.

sources.facts: POST /adsquads/{id}/ads; creative_id required; WEB_VIEW creative maps to REMOTE_WEBPAGE ad; explicit PAUSED. Top request_status + per-row sub_request_status, ads[].ad; exactly one row required by OM.

v3/{pixel_id}/events with query access_token; action_source OFFLINE, SIGN_UP, epoch event_time seconds or milliseconds, user_data.em. Pixel required, not app ID. Only explicitly configured offline definition; no ordinary web signup relabeling.
JSON data array; response status VALID acknowledges ingestion, not attribution. One-event OM payload; no retry or invented reconciliation endpoint.
event_id deduplicates; event_time supports milliseconds. OM conservatively rejects events older than seven days or future events despite offline page documenting wider warning thresholds.
